title: Many Hands Make Light Work: Long-Term Effect Inference for the Experiment Reservoir
abstract: arXiv:2610.36352v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The surrogate index method is the modern standard for estimation of long-term effects in a designed experiment using only short-term outcomes. This method relies on the surrogacy and comparability assumptions which may be violated in practice leading to estimation bias. We propose a new method called Experiment Reservoir Surrogate (ERS) which leverages a reservoir of historical long-term experiments that is common in large-scale experimentation platforms. ERS avoids the surrogacy assumption by predicting the long-term average treatment effect directly, and relaxes the comparability assumption by matching to similar historical experiments, without requiring every experiment in the reservoir to be comparable to the target experiment. Moreover, ERS is memory-efficient, as it only requires aggregate data for each time period, instead of raw individual-level data. translated_title: 众人拾柴火焰高：面向实验库的长期效应推断
translated_abstract: 替代指标方法是当前基于短期结果来估计设计实验中长期效应的现代标准方法。该方法依赖于替代性假设和可比性假设，而这些假设在实践中可能被违反，从而导致估计偏差。我们提出了一种名为实验库替代的新方法，该方法利用大规模实验平台中常见的历史长期实验库。ERS通过直接预测长期平均处理效应来规避替代性假设，并通过匹配相似的历史实验来放松可比性假设，而无需要求实验库中的每个实验都与目标实验可比。此外，ERS具有内存高效性，因为它只需要每个时间段的聚合数据，而不需要原始的个体层面数据。我们从理论上证明了ERS效率的提升，并通过实验展示了其优异表现。
tldr: 提出实验库替代（ERS）方法，利用大规模平台中常见的历史长期实验库直接预测长期平均处理效应，从而规避替代性假设、放松可比性假设，且仅需时间段的聚合数据即可实现高效的长期效应估计。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Experiment Reservoir Surrogate (ERS) method, which leverages a reservoir of historical long-term experiments common in large-scale experimentation platforms to directly predict long-term average treatment effects, thereby avoiding the surrogacy assumption, relaxing comparability, and requiring only aggregate per-period data for memory-efficient estimation.
